create_file_exporter: create a FileExporter instance to save image batches as PNG grids to a directory
save_image_grid: save a numpy batch of images as a single PNG grid file using FileExporter
reshape_image_batch: reshape a batch of images into a grid layout with automatic or fixed grid height
export_with_zoom: export image batches as zoomed PNG grids by setting the zoom parameter on FileExporter
convert_grayscale_to_rgb: convert single channel grayscale image batches to RGB before saving as PNG grids
